svg.title: Computed mesh-refinement sequence of gap impedance and absorber fraction
svg.desc: Only actually solved meshes are plotted. Effective impedance is I-dagger Z I divided by I-dagger I; artificial absorber fraction is distinct from physical plasma absorption.
